# Metrics

Canonical definitions of the shared metrics and the differently defined KPIs the
products report under similar names. Source: `metrics/metrics.yml`.

## active_members

Members who did something (workout, gym visit, attended booking) in the 30 days ending on the last day of the month.

* kind: `distinct_entities_in_window`, grain: month, owner: data-platform
* model: `metric_active_members`, reconciliation: `recon_active_members`
* counts distinct `member_key` of `fct_activity` where `activity_type in ('workout', 'visit', 'booking_attended')` within 30 days

| product | reported as | comparable | expected | threshold % | how the product defines it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `active_users` | yes | higher | 30.0 | Opened the app in the 30 days (no workout needed). |
| B | `active_customers` | yes | higher | 15.0 | Created a booking in the 28 days (attendance not needed, cancellations count). |
| C | `active_members` | yes | higher | 40.0 | Holds a contract on the last day of the month (paused included). |
| D | `billed_customers` | yes | higher | 120.0 | Invoiced in the month (quarterly and annual plans are invoiced rarely). |
| E | `seats_under_contract` | no | n/a | n/a | Seats sold to companies; a corporate seat is not a member. (not comparable: Corporate accounts have no member-level activity, so there is no canonical counterpart.) |

## net_revenue

Tax-inclusive money received minus refunds, by calendar month (Tokyo time).

* kind: `sum_by_month`, grain: month, owner: data-platform
* model: `metric_net_revenue`, reconciliation: `recon_net_revenue`

| product | reported as | comparable | expected | threshold % | how the product defines it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `iap_revenue` | yes | any | 2.0 | In-app purchases, tax-inclusive, month cut in UTC instead of Tokyo time. |
| B | `booking_revenue` | no | n/a | n/a | Tax-exclusive price of bookings whose class falls in the month. (not comparable: Booking prices are not payments; fct_payment holds only A purchases and D invoices/refunds.) |
| C | `monthly_revenue` | no | n/a | n/a | Tax-inclusive monthly fee of contracts alive on the last day of the month. (not comparable: Contract fees are not payments; fct_payment holds only A purchases and D invoices/refunds.) |
| D | `net_sales` | yes | lower | 15.0 | Tax-exclusive invoices minus tax-exclusive refunds. |
| E | `mrr` | no | n/a | n/a | Tax-exclusive monthly fee column of the sales sheet. (not comparable: Corporate contracts are not in fct_payment.) |

## churned_members

Members active in the 30 days ending the previous month-end and not active in the 30 days ending this month-end.

* kind: `lapsed_between_windows`, grain: month, owner: data-platform
* model: `metric_churned_members`, reconciliation: `recon_churned_members`
* derived from `active_members`

| product | reported as | comparable | expected | threshold % | how the product defines it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B | `lost_customers` | no | n/a | n/a | Customers with a booking who created none in 60 days. (not comparable: A booking-inactivity rule of another length; the relationship to canonical churn is not stable.) |
| C | `churned_members` | no | n/a | n/a | Contracts ending in the month (a migration to the new price list counts as a churn). (not comparable: Counts contract events, and the April price-list migration alone multiplies it; no stable relationship.) |
| D | `cancelled_customers` | no | n/a | n/a | Customers not invoiced in 60 days (quarterly/annual plans look cancelled). (not comparable: Invoice cadence, not activity; no stable relationship.) |

## sessions_per_active_member

Activities in the 30-day window divided by active_members over the same window.

* kind: `rows_per_active`, grain: month, owner: data-platform
* model: `metric_sessions_per_active_member`, reconciliation: `recon_sessions_per_active_member`
* derived from `active_members`

| product | reported as | comparable | expected | threshold % | how the product defines it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `workouts_per_user` | yes | lower | 30.0 | Workouts in the month divided by everyone who opened the app. |
| B | `bookings_per_customer` | yes | higher | 60.0 | Bookings created (any status) divided by customers who created one. |
| C | `avg_visits_per_member` | yes | lower | 35.0 | Check-ins divided by everyone holding a contract. |
